what: Quiet stderr bridge omitted for init env-refresh child
scenario_or_breakage: The plan requires every write-design-current-env.sh child to use the LARCH_QUIET_PID 2>&4 bridge (plan.txt:19-25) and pins it for resume in design-route.sh, but the design-init-runparams.sh section only adds larch_err banners and never wraps the existing wdce invocation with the quiet predicate
suggested_fix: Under quiet init, write-design-current-env.sh diagnostics during Step 0b init env-refresh are swallowed while the moved banner tells the operator to inspect those diagnostics; resume failures get the bridge but init failures do not Add the same quiet predicate and 2>&4 redirect to design-init-runparams.sh wdce call, document it in design-init-runparams.md, and pin the predicate in test-design-structure.sh alongside the env-refresh-failed banner migration
